Party Container Automation Setup

Set the opening balance once. After that Purchase adds containers IN and OGP sends containers OUT automatically.

Automation rule: Opening Qty is entered once. Purchase source item + supplier creates automatic IN. OGP return item + receiver party creates automatic OUT. Manual Adjustment is only for corrections, loss, damage or opening changes.

Role Library

Select a role to edit its ERP access.

Super Administrator is protected. Roles control which ERP modules/pages a user can open and the data scope they may see. Own Department Only is ideal for users such as Boiler In-Charge. Actual module pages call the shared ERPAccessControl permission check.

Module Permissions

Control View, Add, Edit, Delete and Print separately for every ERP module.

Registered Page Access

Every future ERP page can register itself here. Give access to only the exact pages this role is allowed to open.

Automatic Access Contract: when a new page such as Boiler Fuel, Steam Cost or Steam Consumption is created, it registers its Page ID and immediately becomes available in this table. No User Management redesign is required.
Future pages: when we create a new ERP page, its connector registers the Page ID here. You then select the role and tick only the actions that role may use. Direct page opening can be blocked with the same permission contract.

Login Security

One common ERP Login Page is used by every user. Each user has a different username and password.

Require LoginWhen enabled, the ERP opens behind the common login screen.
Session TimeoutAutomatic sign-out after this many minutes of inactivity.
Current SessionLocal administrator preview session

Offline-First ERP Sync

Works locally without internet • uploads automatically when connected
Local storage active
The ERP works from local storage first. When the online database is configured, all pending local work uploads automatically whenever a connection is available.
Offline-first mode is active. Your ERP continues working and saving locally even without internet.
create table if not exists public.erp_sync_store (
  tenant_id text not null,
  storage_key text not null,
  storage_value text,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  device_id text,
  primary key (tenant_id, storage_key)
);

alter table public.erp_sync_store enable row level security;

-- Simple testing policy. For production, replace with authenticated-user policies.
create policy "erp_sync_anon_all" on public.erp_sync_store
for all to anon using (true) with check (true);
